title: Granite State Whale Watch
specs: Multiple species of whales including humpback, finback, minke
Dolphins, harbor seals, and occasional sharks
Educational commentary by marine biologist and crew

services.name: Whale Watch
services.desc: Since all whale watchers are ‘guests’ visiting the natural environment of these animals, we consider every whale watch a true expedition. Thus, your whale watch boarding pass is not an admission to a show, but rather an opportunity to observe wild animals which, on a world-wide basis, are quite rare. Whether we sight these marvelous creatures is entirely up to the whales; the probability is quite excellent - we have a 99% sighting record. On the rare occasion that we do not sight any whales or dolphins, a free pass for a future trip will be issued. services.name: Sail With the Professionals
services.desc: Our captains and crew members have well over 100 years combined experience in operating passenger vessels. We enjoy our work and pride ourselves in being able to communicate our enthusiasm about the ocean environment to our passengers. Crew members and naturalists are always available to answer questions throughout

includes: Snacks and drinks available for purchase on board
blurb: Guests join whale watching trips to see multiple species of whales, dolphins, and other marine wildlife. The crew includes knowledgeable guides and a marine biologist who provide educational commentary. Trips last up to 5 hours and include opportunities for photos and videos.

quotes.author: Courtney MacPherson
quotes.text: Courtney MacPherson3 years agoBrought my family whale watching in early August. It was such an awesome experience. The boat was spacious and comfortable(and if you forget your sunglasses like me, they have some for sale at the little shop before you board the boat).The staff were super friendly and informative, and we were able to see tons of wildlife, including a pod of well over 100 dolphins!I would definitely recommend Granite State While Watch & will absolutely be returning in the near furture for more fun whale watching adventures! 🐋😊

quotes.author: Luisa Santacruz
quotes.text: Luisa Santacruz2 years agoOne of the best experiences of my life. The guides were very clear and constantly gave us valuable information about the whales and the ocean…. I recommend bringing snacks and drinks since the tour can last up to 5 hours, in any case you will find a store inside with hot dogs, snacks and drinks at a very good price. We stayed on the first floor and on a sunny day ☀️ like the one we had it was a good idea, since we could rest in the shade.

quotes.author: Tera Baker
quotes.text: Tera Baker2 years agoThe whale watching tour was great! You get an awesome tour for price. Parking $5 owned by city. Word of advice the porty pot on the city lot was the most absolutely disgusting one I have ever seen. It's totally full to the top. This was not owned by the whale watching tour but by the city. Maybe they should take the parking money and add another pot. Would totally do another tour.

quotes.author: Jason
quotes.text: Jason3 years agoWhat a fun and absolutely amazing experience. They took the time to shift us around to see as much as possible, we saw Humpbacks, Minke whales, dolphins and a seal.......The captain moved the boat around so all passengers could see these beautiful animals. The staff were very friendly, knowledgeable, and fun. I can't wait to come back!

quotes.author: Michelle J
quotes.text: Michelle J3 years agoMy family and I had such an awesome time! The crew was professional, friendly, and very knowledgeable. We saw not one momma and her baby but, two momma and baby pairs! They were soo active jumping out of the water and flapping around it was breathtaking. It was an experience we will never forget!

quotes.author: Brianna Downing
quotes.text: Brianna Downing2 years agoAbsolutely incredible experience! This was my first whale watch and it blew me away. We saw incredible marine life - a harbor seal, white sided dolphins, humpback whales and a fin whale - all incredibly beautiful. The crew were so friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. HIGHLY recommend.
